formulas.name: Google XYZ Formula for Impact Bullets
formulas.formula: Accomplished [X] as measured by [Y], by doing [Z].
formulas.example: Increased API throughput by 45% (Y) by refactoring MongoDB query indexes and caching hot endpoints with Redis (Z), reducing user latency (X).

formulas.name: CAR Formula (Context, Action, Result)
formulas.example: Facing high frontend re-render delays in legacy React app, re-architected global state using Redux Toolkit and implemented virtualized lists, cutting page load time by 60%.

sectionAdvice.summary: Keep it to 2-3 sentences max. State title, years of experience/level, key tech stack, and primary value proposition.
sectionAdvice.skills: Group skills logically into categories: Programming Languages, Frameworks & Libraries, Databases, Cloud & DevOps, Tools & Methods.
sectionAdvice.experience: 3-5 bullet points per role. Every bullet MUST start with an impactful past-tense action verb (e.g., Engineed, Architected, Designed, Implemented, Spearheaded).
sectionAdvice.projects: Highlight problem statement, tech stack used, your exact role, and live demo / GitHub link.
